Photoshoot 1.2.0 behaves even more like Photo Booth, fits phones, and has a new home page.

- The countdown lights 3, 2, 1 and then the camera in the toolbar, as Photo Booth does.
- Four quick pictures: one countdown, four rapid shots with a flash each, saved as a 2×2 sheet.
- Option-click the shutter to skip the countdown, Shift-click to skip the flash.
- Picking an effect or backdrop zooms into its tile.
- Reviewing a photo shows a Share icon; press Delete to remove it. The effects pager uses drawn chevrons.
- On phones the window fits the visible screen: the toolbar no longer hides under the browser bar.
- Fixes: a graphics reset mid-countdown cancels the shot and flash; restarting the camera clears any backdrop; the mode control is exactly 94 px.
- The home page is now a working Photoshoot window you can try with your own camera.

Download `Photoshoot-1.2.0-x64.exe` for the Windows 10/11 installer or `Photoshoot-1.2.0-portable.exe` for the portable app. SHA-256 hashes are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

These executables are unsigned, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning (choose More info, then Run anyway). No signed or notarised macOS release is included.

[Open the browser app](https://photoshoot-yeegz.web.app/app/).
